scope: CPU generated data only; no patient/CUDA/server input.

protocol.checkpoint: fixed final step; validation and test not used for selection
protocol.event_generation: conditional bin hazards; censor time independent and occurs after bin; no event by end is administratively censored
protocol.matched_reference: old EMA held frozen in eval mode after same training-only patient/token mean fit; candidate uses explicit frozen fit; gradients enabled
protocol.legacy_ema_arm: old model also trained in train mode with EMA; full-batch repeated fixed inputs make each reference update use the same mean
protocol.baseline_pairing: same optimization, full generated data, parameter counts and copied initial weights
protocol.interaction_off: candidate module retained with identical parameter count and copied initial weights but its logits multiplied by zero; non-interaction heads identically initialized and fully trained
protocol.continuous_redundancy: P=G=Z (standard normal) exactly at first token coordinate; hazard effect = clip(.8*(Z²−1),−1,3); either modality alone determines effect; additivity head is non-linear
protocol.conditioned_arm: synthetic approximation P_conditioned=P+.7*G ONLY for interaction input; additive heads still use P and G separately

limits: No patient data or evidence of clinical benefit.
Old and candidate are mathematically equivalent under paired independent inputs, matched frozen references and copied weights; tiny numerical differences are expected.
The conditioned pathology arm is a deliberately simplified RNA-leakage sensitivity demonstration, not the actual trainable matcher or full DensePathwaySurvival.
The weighted alpha=.5 training objective is not ordinary observed likelihood or necessarily calibrated to the generator.
Ground-truth survival MSE is available only because the generated event hazards are known.
Continuous redundancy deliberately permits a product branch to predict a purely redundant target; a nonzero product or gradient is not evidence of synergy.
The same-sized off arm contains noncontributing interaction parameters; it controls parameter count but does not represent an equally expressive non-interaction model.
Interaction predictions do not identify PID synergy or imply statistical independence.
Full batch fixed-last-step generated results do not test minibatch, real inputs or CUDA behavior.
